moworks.notes: Card tilts about its vertical axis ±8° (0.14 rad); its drop shadow (a flat ellipse under it) moves opposite, x offset = −120 px per rad (±17 px), size unchanged, linked to the angle. Small demo: a continuous sine sway, 3 s period, drawn in 2D (width × cos 4θ, skewY 0.6 θ). Recipe: rotateY −8° → +8° in 800 ms power2.inOut, shadow x linked opposite. Params: angle (±8°) · period (3 s) · shadow: độ trượt bóng (120 px / rad).
